metadataRaw.title: Relieve Hamstring Pain in Seconds #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to relieve hamstring pain with the 'hamstring glider' exercise.

This will help lengthen the muscle for quick relief, and also strengthen at the same time -- which may help get rid of the pain for good.

It can be done at home and may give quick hamstring pain and tightness relief... even within seconds. 

Let us know how it works for you.
